text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Don't you think you've won
enough
already?
choice_data_list: I wouldn't want anyone thinking my skills are half-baked, after all.
I wouldn't want anyone thinking my skills are half-baked, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, well there's no questioning your
skills. So
that's how you judge timing,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, what are we going to do with
all these?
Maybe we can give them to
the student council?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But then I'd have to carry them over
there and
walk into the student council
office with an armful
of plushies...
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone will be all smiles.
I think everyone will be all smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You think this is funny, don't you?
